summary: Achieved 0.13% improvement over baseline (0.997333 → 0.996052) through systematic learning rate optimization. Best configuration: UNEMBEDDING_LR=0.02 (up from 0.004, +0.108%) and MATRIX_LR=0.06 (up from 0.04). Explored 6 distinct approaches: LR increases, weight decay reduction, warmup, Adam beta tuning, and scalar LR adjustment. Only UNEMBEDDING_LR and MATRIX_LR increases provided improvement; all other variations degraded performance. This suggests the model is sensitive to layer-specific learning rates and benefits from more aggressive training of both embedding layers.
